messages:
sara_sales: Quick heads-up — enterprise prospect RDX-191 wants a single packaged offer: Redwood API + Optimize (batch scoring) + Console add-ons, 12mo commit. Security Qs mostly answered but they asked for a blended rate and an engineering POC window. Who can own pricing/POC coordination?
alex_m: I can take SE lead on the POC. need their expected QPS and peak token distribution. do they expect streaming?
maya_se: POC notes from earlier: they need <50ms p95 for short responses, and a nightly bulk optimize job (~200M tokens/month). For latency SLO we should run on Dedicated GPUs for the POC. also: they require SSO (SAML) + data redaction controls.
ian_sre: security checklist: SOC2 is fine; customer asked for on-prem pen test and an IP allowlist. pen test we can accept under our standard AUP but need legal signoff. SAML + KMS support available in Private/Dedicated.
emily_revops: For pricing, we need to confirm commit level before we talk discounts. Current public ratecard: API = $2.50 / 1M tokens, Optimize = $75 / model-hour, Console seats = $30/user/mo. What commit are they thinking?
sara_sales: They verbally mentioned $200k ARR commit for 12 months. want blended effective unit price ~20% off list across the bundle. Also asking if POC can be free for 2 weeks.
emily_revops: 20% off across-products is large; typically discounts by commit band: 12mo $100-250k => 10-15% max without exec signoff. For cross-product combos we can offer additive crediting: e.g., commit credits applied first to API usage, then Optimize. We need Deal Desk approval for 20% and any free POC.
alex_m: For the POC infra we can do a 2-week limited Dedicated pool with quota caps (no free unlimited). propose: 2-week trial with $0 infra charge but enforced token/hour and model-hour caps; if they want unlimited we'd convert to a paid short-term burst. keeps costs contained.
emily_revops: Trackable terms to request from deal desk: commit amount, discount %, POC duration/infra caps, overage rates, data retention & redaction clause, SSO/SAML support, pen-test approval. I'll open a formal approval.
sara_sales: Can we do a quick sketch of an approved concession that won't require exec signoff? maybe 12mo $200k -> 12% blended? plus 2-week constrained POC (caps) and standard SSO + KMS.
emily_revops: That sounds within delegated authority if we enforce the POC caps and no custom legal terms. I'll draft the concession: 12% off list across API/Optimize/Console, POC = 2 weeks with caps: API 150M tokens total, Optimize 20 model-hours, Console 5 seats. Overages billed at list. Include standard data processing addendum.
maya_se: Technical checklist to include before POC kickoff: sample prompt shapes, token length distribution, TLS certs for ingestion endpoint, SAML SP metadata, and a redaction runbook for sensitive fields. I'll email the checklist to their security contact.
dealbot: Approval workflow started: DEAL-APPROVAL-482 created. Required approvers: emily_revops, legal, finance. ETA 48h.
sara_sales: perfect. alex — can you schedule a 30min kickoff with their infra lead for Monday? put the POC plan in the doc I send to Deal Desk.
alex_m: on it. scheduling now. will attach the POC quota table and a short config snippet for Dedicated pool sizing.
sara_sales: thanks team. i'll hold off on promising a 20% deep discount until Deal Desk confirms. :thumbsup:
ian_sre: one more note — if they insist on a customer-owned key in HSM, that bumps us to Private deployment; flag that early to avoid surprises.
emily_revops: noted. will add 'HSM/customer-managed KMS' as an escalation item.
sara_sales: ok closing loop. target: deal desk ticket approved + POC kickoff scheduled by EOW. any blockers call them out now.
alex_m: none from engineering side.
maya_se: none. I'll start the checklist email.
sara_sales: thanks all! :rocket:
